description: Open the running app in Chromium on every screen size, color scheme and language, and report what is broken: page overflow, cut-off text, overlaps, contrast, dark-mode leaks, small tap targets, console errors, failed requests, broken images, layout shift, off-style values. Compares with the previous run of the same URL: an issue that went away because its element was hidden, removed or shrunk is a cover-up. Returns the report and the contact sheet. Run it before calling a UI change done, and again after fixing.

baseline.description: Run to compare with: auto (default, the previous run of the same URL), none, or a run directory.

darkStrategy.description: How dark mode is switched on: media (default), class:dark, or attr:data-theme=dark.

ignore.description: CSS selectors to leave out of every check.

localeStrategy.description: How the app picks its language: browser (default), path:/{locale}, query:<param>, cookie:<name> or storage:<key>.

locales.description: Languages, e.g. ["en", "vi"]; "pseudo" stretches the first language's text about 40%, "pseudo-rtl" also lays it out right to left. Default ["en"].

out.description: Output directory. Default .mantis in the server's working directory.

routes.description: Routes to visit, e.g. ["/", "/settings"]. Default: the path of url.

schemes.description: Color schemes: light, dark. Default both.

storageState.description: A Playwright storage state JSON file (cookies and localStorage) for pages behind a login. Keep it out of git.

url.description: The page to check, e.g. http://localhost:3000. Routes are resolved against it.

viewports.description: Screen sizes: mobile (360x740), tablet (768x1024), desktop (1440x900), or WxH. Default all three.

name: mantis_look
title: Look at the UI
